headline: VW eBike smartglasses improve rider safety with HUD display, $500
summary: Smartglasses for VW eBikes offer enhanced safety features and data display
details: The Volkswagen eBike from N+ comes with optional smartglasses that provide a heads-up display, showing vital information such as speed, distance, and blind spot alerts. These glasses weigh 47 grams and have an eight-hour battery life. They connect to both Android and iOS devices, and are compatible with Google Maps.

The smartglasses display data including blind spot alerts and navigation prompts, and use eye-tracking to activate. They also sync with Wear OS and Apple's Watch OS to show exercise data. The glasses can be used beyond the VW eBike, but specific details on this functionality are not provided.

The VW eBike is available in two models: Sport and Crossover, both with a Yamaha power unit, 250W of power, a top assisted speed of 15mph, and a maximum range of about 100 miles on a charge. Prices start at $4,000 for the Sport eBike and $4,350 for the Crossover model. The smart glasses cost an extra $500, while the smart helmet is $400.
The VW eBike range from N+ is available to pre-order now and is expected to be released between October and December this year. A fully kitted out, smart VW eBike could cost as much as $5,250.

headline_marked: 9 Tips to Get More Out of [[Google Chat]]
headline: 9 Tips to Get More Out of Google Chat
summary: Discover how to make the most of Google Chat's features
details: Google Chat is a feature-packed messaging app with seamless connections to other Google apps and services. It's free to use on the web, Android, and iOS. The app offers various features, including Spaces, threaded messages, and message scheduling.

Spaces in Google Chat work like supercharged group chats, allowing users to work on projects or discuss topics with selected people. They can have names and descriptions, and tasks can be assigned to specific people. File sharing is also handled more elegantly in Spaces.

Google Chat supports threaded messages, enabling users to spin off separate tangents within conversations without interrupting the larger flow. These threads are available in one-to-one chats, group chats, and Spaces.

Users can pin important conversations to the top of the list, and organize conversations into sections, such as friends, family members, and work colleagues. Sections can be created on the web, but not on mobile.

Google Chat also allows users to schedule messages for delivery up to 120 days in advance on the web app. Additionally, the app integrates well with other Google products, such as Google Calendar, Google Drive, and Google Tasks.
